plugins.name: tmux-pair
plugins.description: Spawn solo (single agent + gated subagent-driven self-review), pair (writer/reviewer), or triple (writer/reviewer/orchestrator) agent runs in fresh git worktrees, wired up via tmux. Includes the orchestration script, slash commands (/solo, /pair, /triple), the tmux-pair-orchestration skill, PROJECT.md care, scoped subagents for the gates, sender identity prefixes, explicit parallel-plan markers, auto-detection of repo-specific subagents (`.claude/agents/<repo>-*.md`) listed in every briefing, shipped rules templates for 7 stacks, bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), and pi as third coding agent alongside claude + codex.
